outcomes.description: Search ran but no member exists with the given member number; no name or balance can be returned.
App-side validation rejected the member number (e.g. not 5 digits / non-numeric); search never ran.
Teller lacks permission to view this member (restricted account); member details are withheld.

input.notes:
Flow: on the Member Inquiry search form (main.html, content in the right-hand iframe), type the member number into the Member ID textbox and click Search. On success the member_detail screen shows a Member Summary table (Name / Member No) and an accounts table with columns Sfx, Description, Account, Balance.

Outputs: member_name is read from the value cell next to the "Name:" label. share_savings_balance is read from the Balance cell of the row whose Description is "Share Savings" (suffix 00). Note the accounts table can contain several rows (e.g. "Share Draft Checking" suffix 10) — match on the "Share Savings" description rather than on row position, in case a member's account list is ordered differently or contains extra sub-accounts. If a member has no Share Savings row at all, that balance will not be extractable.

This is a read-only lookup: no irreversible actions are involved. The member_detail screen also offers "Open Sub-Account" (subacct_form and the subacct_* states) and "New Inquiry" links — both are outside this goal and were not used.

Interstitials that may appear at replay and are handled by the app's state library: system_notice (dismiss), service_unavailable (retry), session_expired / signed_out (re-auth). member_alert is deliberately NOT auto-dismissed — if it appears after the search, a human must read and act on it via request_help before the member_detail screen can be read. None of these appeared during this run.
